subject: general
question: In which month did the Essential Defence Services Bill, 2021 receive the assent of the President?
solution:
The correct answer is **August 2021.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Essential Defence Services Bill,2021**

 
 
• An Act to **provide for the maintenance of essential defence services so as to secure the security of the nation and the life and property of the public at large and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.**
